dedupe_keys.name: electric vehicle charging transactions with charger and user identifiers

description: The EV charging transactions research team publishes 72,856 charging sessions from 2,119 chargers operated by a commercial provider. The Figshare record describes persistent charger and user identifiers together with charger-location categories, allowing behaviour to be studied from either perspective. It supplies one CSV file and a companion code archive, publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one annual commercial operating period; exact dates and geographic limits are not stated in the inspected deposit metadata. The transactions can calibrate charging-demand and siting simulations that connect model-sumo mobility scenarios with model-pypsa electricity planning. A caveat is that the repository and article give different user totals, so no exact user count is asserted here. Operator-specific participation and unregistered users also affect interpretation. No CSV rows or archived code were downloaded.
